biotools.summary: The AIBL Distance-to-Boundary model uses novelty detection and distance metrics to identify individuals at risk of developing Alzheimer's disease based on data from the AIBL study. It includes a GUI for non-technical stakeholders and a distance-to-boundary strategy for risk assessment.
